item.title: Redstone Plus Add-On
item.creator: Causeway Digital
item.description:
Expand your redstone contraption capabilities to new heights!

- 16 new redstone connecting blocks
- Detect mobs from a distance with the Mob Detector
- Transmit redstone through the air with wireless transmitters / wireless lamps
- Transport items up with an Item Elevator
- Build circuits with 7 different logic gates

Add this Add-On to any world!

faqEntries.heading: How can you craft the Redstone Plus Guidebook?
faqEntries.content:
You will be automatically given the guidebook first time when you enter the world, but if you've lost it, it is easy to craft.
You need 1 book and 4 redstone dust.
In a crafting bench, place the book in the centre, with a piece of redstone dust in the 4 spots around the book. 
All other crafting recipes can be found within the guidebook.

faqEntries.heading: What is the maximum range of the wireless redstone unit and wireless lamp?
faqEntries.content: There is no defined maximum range. If the chunk is loaded (for example a player is nearby), the wireless signal will be transmitted/received.

faqEntries.heading: Can you swap the direction of the Redstone Tower?
faqEntries.content: Yes, interacting (right clicking) with the Redstone Tower will flip its direction round so the redstone signal can transfer down, instead of the usual up.

item.howToTitle: How to use the Redstone Plus Add-On

howToEntries.heading: Step 1: Purchase the add-on
howToEntries.content: Purchase the add-on from the Minecraft Marketplace and download it.

howToEntries.heading: Step 2a: Add the add-on to a new world
howToEntries.content: Select the Activate Add-On button -> Select New -> Select Create.

howToEntries.heading: Step 2b : Add the add-on to an exisiting world
howToEntries.content: Select the Activate Add-On button -> Select Existing-> Select your chosen world -> Select Copy and Continue -> Select Play.
